findings.title: Primary monitoring dependency lacks test evidence
findings.detail: LC03 is supported by a build-complete assertion but no accessible monitoring exception test.
findings.recommendation: Obtain and review a scenario-specific test before supporting a launch decision.

findings.title: Reconciliation test retains an unresolved timing exception
findings.detail: One $50.00 payment remains pending at 60 minutes against an illustrative 30-minute resolution criterion; conservation of value alone passes.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the timing failure mechanism and retest normal and delayed paths.

findings.title: Exit design has not been rehearsed
findings.detail: LC06 has a written recovery plan but no executed rehearsal record.
findings.recommendation: Rehearse access withdrawal, pending-item reconciliation, and recovery evidence before approval consideration.

limitations: The product, approval criteria, roles, amounts, and tests are fictional.
Passing fixture tests does not establish full control coverage or production readiness.
No actual launch, pilot, or risk exception is approved.
The missing monitoring test is an evidence gap, not proof that the control was absent.
conclusion: Three critical launch conditions remain unresolved in the fictional review, so the evidence does not support launch consideration yet. Obtain the monitoring test, resolve the reconciliation exception, and rehearse exit before an authorized human decision.
report_narrative: Three critical conditions remain unresolved, so the fixture evidence does not support launch consideration yet. Monitoring test evidence, reconciliation timing, and exit rehearsal require resolution before an authorized launch decision.

The fictional payment-request product has five principal flow legs and six approval conditions. Instructions, data, and funds are mapped separately; the provider executes funds transfers while the request service handles instructions.

LC03 lacks an inspectable monitoring exception test, LC04 has an unresolved timing exception, and LC06 lacks a performed exit rehearsal. These are different evidence states and remain distinct in the recommendation.

FlowMap shows enrollment data, instruction service, review data, funds execution, and reconciliation data. Repeated representations of the same payment value must not be summed as separate economic exposure.

Three conditions are SATISFIED, one PARTIAL, one NOT VERIFIABLE, and one NOT SATISFIED. Five conditions are critical; three remain unresolved. The $100.00 test instruction total equals $50.00 posted plus $50.00 pending, but the pending item is 60 minutes old against a 30-minute criterion.

SYN-001 supplies the product version, flow map, six conditions, three payment records, and four-operator training evidence. Successful fixture screening tests support only their defined cases, not complete production control coverage.

Propose obtaining LC03’s actual test evidence, resolving and retesting the delayed reconciliation path, and rehearsing exit with pending activity. Any narrower pilot needs enforceable scope, capacity, stop criteria, and a human-approved decision.
QA preserves all six conditions and prevents minor passes from cancelling critical gaps. No launch, pilot, limit change, waiver, or funds movement is authorized by this review.
